label: TrueNAS R50 4U hybrid storage appliance
description: 4U (scalable to 12U) hybrid storage appliance. The onboard pair is 2x SFP+ 10GbE (enp1s0f0/enp1s0f1) plus a dedicated 1GBase-T OOBM port; faster and copper networking is an add-in card, not these ports: 2x 10/25/40/100GbE (QSFP28, SR4 optics), 2 or 6x 10GBase-T or SR, and optionally 2x 32Gb Fibre Channel.
notes: Modelled as the onboard pair, which is what the interface names mean: enp1s0f0/f1 are the onboard 10GbE NICs from the product manual's 'Onboard Networking 2x 10 GbE'. The manual also lists 'Additional Networking 1 (optional) 2x 10/25/40/100 GbE', which is a QSFP28 card in a different slot with different interface names - modelling it here would have meant relabelling an onboard NIC as a 100G cage, which is the contradiction issue #59 was about. A 100G configuration would be a separate catalogue entry, not a change of connector on these ports.
